strong_baselines.BSGS_PORTFOLIO: same fixed base order; cumulative charged work until factor or four bases exhausted
strong_baselines.RHO_PORTFOLIO: same fixed base order; cumulative charged work until factor or four bases exhausted
strong_baselines.strong_reference: minimum cumulative arithmetic work among successful BSGS_PORTFOLIO and RHO_PORTFOLIO; no oracle selection before execution

frozen_gates.criterion: all UFK returned factors are exact nontrivial divisors and every promoted certificate replays
UFK factors at least 90% of the 30 blind cases
at least 60% of cases emit an exact nonterminal projection and at least 50% of UFK successes terminate through a projection-derived factor path
at least 50% of cases record at least one exact DAG or M2R reuse hit
no cap bypass; any overflow returns OPEN_* with frozen frontier witness rather than negative evidence
median UFK/strong-baseline arithmetic-work ratio <= 1.0 among mutually successful cases
p, q and true order are evaluation-only and never passed to UFK or baselines

verdict_policy.PASS_EXACT_AND_ARCHITECTURAL_SIGNAL__NOT: G1-G5 and G7 pass but G6 fails
verdict_policy.REFUTED_ARCHITECTURAL_UTILITY: G1 passes but one or more of G2-G5 fail without a resource UNKNOWN
verdict_policy.UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT: execution cannot complete frozen scope because of explicit resource limit
verdict_policy.CERTIFICATE_FAILURE: any promoted exact certificate fails replay
